label: catalogue records
definition: One record of the library's catalogue as transcribed and identified in the UQAM edition (Projet La Flèche, Université du Québec à Montréal), taken by the project in March 2026.
also: 2,092 have a candidate digital copy found by automated search, 934 of them matched with confidence. A digital copy found by automated search is a candidate match, not a verified identification of the catalogue copy. | The records stand under 22 section labels. Section headings are counted as transcribed; a few are spelling variants of one another.

label: indexed works
definition: A work the project selected from the catalogue for processing, or a contextual text studied beside it; every indexed work is listed in the works index.
also: 101 are works recorded in the catalogue and 3 are contextual texts.

label: works with a page
definition: Given to every indexed work that has a machine-read text or a recorded activity; the other indexed works were selected and not yet processed, and the index gives the recorded reason for each.

label: works with a processed text
definition: One machine-read text made from one scan; a work can have several (volumes, or an earlier and a later ingestion), and only current ones are counted.

label: works screened
definition: The first screening against Hume's texts was run on the work.

label: works studied closely
definition: Comparisons with Hume are held, or the work has been audited or made the subject of a campaign.

label: works with published working texts (22 texts)
definition: A working machine-read text that can be read on this site.
